plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instructions used hardcoded nth-of-type CSS selectors that became stale after checklyhq.com updated its navigation bar layout. As a result, replaying the cached steps clicked the 'Solutions' menu item instead of 'Developers', navigating to '/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' and causing the URL assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: The cached runSource replayed selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button', which clicked the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
The action resulted in navigating to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/'.
The assertion `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` failed due to the incorrect navigation path.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai instruction cache and retry test execution
remediationSteps.details: Clear the deterministic page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run the automation suite so page.ai can resolve the updated DOM selectors for the navigation menu.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache and retrying the test will allow Donobu's AI agent to re-analyze the live page, locate the 'Developers' dropdown and 'Documentation' menu link correctly, and complete the flow successfully.
